description: This file defines the IEventHubQueueCache interface, which specifies methods for managing a cache of EventHub EventData messages, including adding messages, retrieving cursors, fetching the next message, adding cache pressure monitors, and signaling cache purges.

classes.name: IEventHubQueueCache
classes.description: Interface for a stream message cache that stores EventHub EventData, supporting cache management and stream reading operations.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a list of EventData messages to the cache with a specified dequeue time.

methods.name: GetCursor
methods.description: Retrieves a cursor object into the cache for reading events from a specific stream and sequence token.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the next message from the cache for a given cursor.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Adds a cache pressure monitor to the cache's back pressure control mechanism.

methods.name: SignalPurge
methods.description: Signals the cache to perform a time-based purge of cached messages.
